bounties.title: Build a Next.js Starter Template
bounties.description: Create a comprehensive Next.js 14 starter template with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and authentication setup. Should include best practices for folder structure and configuration.

bounties.title: FastAPI + PostgreSQL Template
bounties.description: Develop a production-ready FastAPI template with PostgreSQL integration, Docker setup, SQLAlchemy ORM, Alembic migrations, and basic CRUD operations. Include authentication and API documentation.

bounties.title: Discord Bot Starter Template
bounties.description: Create a Discord bot template using discord.py with command handling, event listeners, database integration, and deployment configuration for Railway. Include examples for common bot features.
